name: Harvesting the Harvesters
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.

narrative.details:
Oh no... I'm in for it now!

I heard about the harvesters terrorizing the fields of Westfall, so I traveled all the way from Ironforge to see if I could recalibrate them. But they're far more aggressive than my calculations anticipated, and they chased me into this stable!

If I had some isosprings and gyrostabilizers from the harvesters, I could build a device to cover my escape. Could you gather the parts for me?
narrative.objectives: Ozwin Ironsprocket at Saldean's Farm wants you to bring him 14 Golem Isosprings and 5 Harvester Gyrostabilizers.
narrative.offerRewardText: Thanks a bunch! I'll get to work on an escape plan. In the meantime, take this!
narrative.requestItemsText: It's a mess out there, Theto! Did you collect the parts I need?
